- **Green_stem_disorder ref**: Shows green stems persisting alongside dried/dead pods — directly matches the stay-green pattern in the test image.
- **Sudden_death_syndrome ref**: Field with patches of dying plants, no stay-green feature.
- **Phytophthora ref**: Wilted plant with brown dying leaves, not a mature-field stay-green scenario.
- **Brown_Stem_Rot ref**: Internal stem browning cross-section, unrelated visual pattern.

The defining feature — one plant remaining green while an entire mature field has senesced and died — is the hallmark of Green_stem_disorder.
